body:
📦 **meadow-spacekey `66813d2`** — fix(ui): use a space-key symbol on control buttons

Display U+2423 (␣) for bindings assigned to Space in control-button and
keyboard-cap labels, including volley and first-person jump. Keep full
readable names in tooltips, prose and rebinding fields, and follow custom
bindings instead of hard-coding the volley label. Update HUD repaint and
initial markup together so the word does not reappear after rendering.

Verify display names, readable Space names and rebound J/F labels; rebuild
the standalone core and sync the Blocksail shell.

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
